body.title: Converge the two renderers into one, define the absent-sizeClass case, rename, and keep the standalone shim
body.summary: Collapse the dispatch ternary at standalone-record.ts:198-200 into ONE renderer emitting each section keyed on its OWN content — the union of what both renderers emit today, nothing dropped — with the title derived from meta.sizeClass rather than meta.standalone. sizeClass is the right discriminator and is immune to the validate flip: optional on BuildRecord.meta (:49), required on StandaloneBuildRecord.meta (:94), written on the standalone route (implement.ts:135), never written by validate. BUT s1 surfaced a committed counterexample the design's premise missed: review claim p1 established sizeClass appears ONLY on standalone records and never established the CONVERSE, and BUILD-be8708a9cd20e286-s1 is standalone true with NO sizeClass — so :116's `${rec.meta.sizeClass}` renders a title containing the literal 'undefined' TODAY. The converged renderer must DEFINE the absent case rather than inherit that defect. Also rename renderPlanBuildRecordMd to renderBuildRecordMd — 1 production site plus ~17 references across two committed suites, mechanical but spanning suites that must be RUN — and retain renderStandaloneBuildRecordMd as a delegating shim, since build-record.test.ts imports and calls it. SECTION COUNT: of the nine sections §2.4 enumerates, TWO always render (title, created/updated line) and SEVEN are conditional omit-slots (Commit, Scope, Triage rationale, Summary, Tasks validated, Changes, Feedback). The LLD's test strategy says 'eight omit-slots', matching neither — assert against the seven actually counted rather than inheriting an unverified number. CRITIQUE APPLIED: c4 added to derivedFrom, since §2.4's renderPlanBuildRecordMd is the very function being converged and renamed and was the citation graph's weakest link.
acceptanceChecks: One renderer: the ternary at standalone-record.ts:198-200 is gone and no code path selects a renderer on meta.standalone

ABSENT sizeClass has a DEFINED title: a standalone record with no sizeClass renders a well-formed heading containing no 'undefined' substring — asserted against the real BUILD-be8708a9cd20e286-s1 fixture, not a constructed approximation
That same record's body.tasks RENDER under the converged renderer, where today they are invisible in the markdown while sitting in the json

Each of the SEVEN conditional sections is asserted present-when-populated and absent-when-not, one assertion per section, and the two unconditional ones are asserted always present — counted, not inherited
The title derives from meta.sizeClass, asserted against a record whose standalone is false but whose sizeClass is set: the flipped state, which must still render the standalone title
A record carrying both body.focus and body.tasks renders BOTH '## Scope' and '## Tasks validated'
STANDALONE-ROUTE rendering of body.summary and body.commit now works — the half deliberately deferred from t7
t2's goldens 1 and 2 are BYTE-IDENTICAL after the convergence; golden 3 changes, and its diff is reviewed as the intended repair of the 'undefined' title and the invisible tasks
t1's TEST A (the lost '## Scope') is INVERTED in this same change — rewritten to assert the correct behaviour, not deleted and not skipped
renderPlanBuildRecordMd is renamed to renderBuildRecordMd; both affected suites (build-record-enrichment.test.ts, provenance-build.test.ts) are RUN GREEN, not merely compiled
renderStandaloneBuildRecordMd still exports and returns identical output, delegating rather than duplicating

ABSENT sizeClass renders a well-formed title containing no 'undefined' — asserted against the real BUILD-be8708a9cd20e286-s1 fixture

a record with both `focus` and `tasks` renders both '## Scope' and '## Tasks validated'

an empty or absent changeLog still renders NO '## Changes' section
BYTE-IDENTITY HELD: goldens 1 and 2 are unchanged by the convergence; golden 3's diff is the single reviewed, intended change
